STOCKHOLDERS' AGREEMENT
NORTHWIND HOLDINGS, INC.
Dated as of April 1, 2022

This Stockholders' Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into by and among Northwind Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), and each of the persons executing this Agreement as a Stockholder (each, a "Stockholder").

RECITALS
WHEREAS, the Stockholders own all of the issued and outstanding capital stock of the Company; and
WHEREAS, the parties desire to set forth their agreement with respect to the governance of the Company, transfer restrictions, and certain other matters.

1. GOVERNANCE
1.1 Board Composition. The Board of Directors shall consist of five (5) directors: three (3) designated by the Series A Preferred holders and two (2) designated by the Common holders.
1.2 Board Observer. Each holder of 10% or more of the outstanding Preferred Stock shall be entitled to designate one non-voting board observer.
1.3 Protective Provisions. So long as any Series A Preferred remains outstanding, the Company shall not, without the affirmative vote of holders of a majority of the Series A Preferred:
   (a) amend the Certificate of Incorporation or Bylaws in a manner adverse to the Preferred;
   (b) create any senior or pari passu series of stock;
   (c) approve a Sale of the Company;
   (d) incur indebtedness in excess of $2,000,000;
   (e) pay any dividend on the Common Stock;
   (f) enter into any related-party transaction with a value exceeding $250,000.

2. TRANSFER RESTRICTIONS
2.1 Right of First Refusal. Before transferring any shares to a third party, the transferring Stockholder shall offer such shares to the Company and then to the other Stockholders, on the same terms.
2.2 Co-Sale Right. If a Founder proposes to transfer more than 5% of its shares, the other Preferred holders shall have the right to participate in the sale on a pro rata basis.
2.3 Drag-Along. If holders of a majority of the outstanding Common and a majority of the outstanding Preferred approve a Sale of the Company, all Stockholders shall vote in favor and shall transfer their shares on the same terms.

3. INFORMATION RIGHTS
3.1 Each Preferred holder shall receive audited annual financial statements within 90 days of fiscal year-end, unaudited quarterly financial statements within 45 days of quarter-end, and monthly management reports.
3.2 Each Preferred holder shall have the right of reasonable inspection of the Company's books and records, subject to DGCL § 220 as applied through this Agreement.

4. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES
Each Stockholder represents and warrants that (i) it has full authority to execute this Agreement, (ii) its execution does not conflict with any other agreement, and (iii) the shares owned by it are held free and clear of any encumbrance other than as disclosed on Schedule 4.

5. MISCELLANEOUS
5.1 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
5.2 Dispute Resolution. Any dispute arising out of this Agreement shall be resolved in the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware.
5.3 Amendment. This Agreement may be amended only by a writing signed by the Company, holders of a majority of the Common, and holders of a majority of the Preferred.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

NORTHWIND HOLDINGS, INC.
